why_ai: Item economies keep growing, but custody, settlement and surveillance are software work.
why_clarity: Settlement is reliable, but supply and pricing decisions are made by design instinct.
why_digital: Virtual items traded, settled and paid out entirely online.

why_ai: Off-the-shelf authentication, holds and anomaly response close the gap without human judgment.
why_clarity: Known custodian-grade controls either exist on an account or do not.
why_digital: Account security controls run entirely in software.

why_ai: Income forecasting and payout transparency are data products software can build.
why_clarity: Payout formulas are computable, but discovery effects make declines hard to diagnose.
why_digital: Platform currency and payouts handled entirely online.

why_ai: Litigation, regulators and minors make this a legal posture call with accountable counsel.
why_clarity: No settled rule defines a defensible position, and outcomes arrive through litigation.
why_digital: Third-party sites and items monitored online, with legal work on documents.

why_ai: Graph and sequence analysis over the full trade record is machine surveillance, though adversaries adapt.
why_clarity: Every trade is recorded and scored the same way, though ground truth is sparse.
why_digital: Trade records analysed entirely in software.

why_ai: Policing real-value markets is adversarial, but surveillance and controls are largely automatable.
why_clarity: Wash trading and manipulation patterns are definable, though enforcement lines are contested.
why_digital: Order books and trade logs policed entirely online.

why_ai: Setting drop rates and sinks is consequential economic judgment with delayed, tangled effects.
why_clarity: Designers set parameters by instinct, and price effects are confounded with engagement.
why_digital: Game parameters and market data handled entirely on screen.

why_ai: Aggregating trades into reference prices and indices is mechanical work.
why_clarity: Reference price, volume and depth are computed exactly from the trade record.
why_digital: Trade data in, published price indices out.

why_ai: Fully recorded thefts make reversal and restitution a policy plus automation question.
why_clarity: Compromise, trades and destination accounts are all recorded and traceable.
why_digital: Support cases and item reversals handled entirely online.

why_ai: Seizing valuable inventories and judging laundering are consequential, sometimes legal, decisions.
why_clarity: Cases recur, but laundering judgments are ambiguous and rarely confirmed.
why_digital: Case queues and account histories reviewed on screen.

why_ai: Defining obligations between terms of service and financial regulation needs accountable compliance judgment.

why_digital: Identity, funding and trade data assessed entirely in software.
